dataset: NIST StRD Longley (1967) — certified regression reference values
source: National Institute of Standards and Technology, Statistical Reference Datasets (itl.nist.gov/div898/strd)
model: y = b0 + b1*defl + b2*gnp + b3*unemp + b4*armed + b5*pop + b6*year + e

tolerances.notes: Longley is deliberately ill-conditioned (NIST difficulty: higher). Householder QR in double precision recovers coefficients to roughly 6-8 significant digits. Tolerances are method-appropriate per the numerical correctness policy.
